subtitle_sync_rule: each subtitle block is derived from the exact narration text for its scene

scenes.title: Dashboard Overview
scenes.narration: This console opens with a live dashboard that summarizes job volume, application activity, and recent automation runs in one place.
scenes.subtitle:
This console opens with a live dashboard that summarizes
job volume, application activity, and recent automation
runs in one place.
scenes.action_summary: Moves across live KPI cards and the recent-runs area on the dashboard.

scenes.title: Dashboard Analytics
scenes.narration: The dashboard also exposes a density map and an applied trend chart, so the operator can read coverage and momentum before taking action.
scenes.subtitle:
The dashboard also exposes a density map and an applied
trend chart, so the operator can read coverage and
momentum before taking action.
scenes.action_summary: Scrolls through the map and trend views and performs basic mouse interaction.

scenes.title: Jobs Workspace
scenes.narration: Jobs is the main working queue, with filtering, sorting, paging, and stage aware status handling for roles that still need attention.
scenes.subtitle:
Jobs is the main working queue, with filtering, sorting,
paging, and stage aware status handling for roles that
still need attention.
scenes.action_summary: Shows the jobs queue, sort controls, scrolling, and the active table state.

scenes.title: Job Detail Modal
scenes.narration: Each row can open a structured job detail view, making it easier to review normalized fields before any rewrite or apply step.
scenes.subtitle:
Each row can open a structured job detail view, making it
easier to review normalized fields before any rewrite or
apply step.
scenes.action_summary: Opens a real job detail modal and scrolls inside it before closing.

scenes.title: Generate CV
scenes.narration: When a role is ready, the operator can generate a tailored CV artifact directly from the queue instead of preparing documents by hand.
scenes.subtitle:
When a role is ready, the operator can generate a tailored
CV artifact directly from the queue instead of preparing
documents by hand.
scenes.action_summary: Highlights a live Generate CV action in the jobs table without mutating data.

scenes.title: CV Preview Loading
scenes.narration: The preview modal now makes loading explicit, so path assembly and artifact materialization read as progress instead of an error.
scenes.subtitle:
The preview modal now makes loading explicit, so path
assembly and artifact materialization read as progress
instead of an error.
scenes.action_summary: Opens a real CV preview modal and waits while loading text and materialized paths appear.

scenes.title: Apply Actions
scenes.narration: If artifacts already exist, the same workspace exposes apply and manual confirmation actions so the application lifecycle stays explicit.
scenes.subtitle:
If artifacts already exist, the same workspace exposes
apply and manual confirmation actions so the application
lifecycle stays explicit.
scenes.action_summary: Highlights live Apply and Mark Applied Manual actions in the queue.

scenes.title: Applied Jobs
scenes.narration: Applied Jobs keeps submitted roles separate, including apply dates and status history checks for downstream follow up.
scenes.subtitle:
Applied Jobs keeps submitted roles separate, including
apply dates and status history checks for downstream
follow up.
scenes.action_summary: Shows the dedicated applied-jobs table and scrolls within that workspace.

scenes.title: Reposts Analytics
scenes.narration: Reposts Analytics keeps the grouped repost view available and lets the operator jump back into Jobs with preset filters for the next pass.
scenes.subtitle:
Reposts Analytics keeps the grouped repost view available
and lets the operator jump back into Jobs with preset
filters for the next pass.
scenes.action_summary: Shows the analytics table and moves across the grouped results surface.

scenes.title: Language Trends
scenes.narration: Language Trends combines local demand with external context and a Qwen lens that expands the argument across market and policy dimensions.
scenes.subtitle:
Language Trends combines local demand with external
context and a Qwen lens that expands the argument across
market and policy dimensions.
scenes.action_summary: Switches to Language Trends, shows the local trend view, and highlights the Qwen lens.

scenes.title: Stack Trends
scenes.narration: Stack Trends adds stack-family grouping and crawl recommendations for thin buckets so weak signals stay visibly provisional.
scenes.subtitle:
Stack Trends adds stack-family grouping and crawl
recommendations for thin buckets so weak signals stay
visibly provisional.
scenes.action_summary: Switches to Stack Trends, shows the grouped stack view, and highlights crawl guidance.

scenes.title: Learning And Interview Support
scenes.narration: Learning Quiz adds a lightweight knowledge layer, and Interview Q and A can prepare interview prompts from job context and CV inputs.
scenes.subtitle:
Learning Quiz adds a lightweight knowledge layer, and
Interview Q and A can prepare interview prompts from job
context and CV inputs.
scenes.action_summary: Switches between learning subtabs and shows the Interview Q and A inputs.

scenes.title: Automation Schedules
scenes.narration: Automation schedules recurring crawl, learning, prediction, repair, and cleanup flows without forcing the operator back into the terminal.
scenes.subtitle:
Automation schedules recurring crawl, learning,
prediction, repair, and cleanup flows without forcing the
operator back into the terminal.
scenes.action_summary: Shows automation controls, the create action, and the schedules block.

scenes.title: Automation Runs
scenes.narration: The runs view closes the loop with progress, logs, and recovery actions, turning the console into a practical daily operations surface.
scenes.subtitle:
The runs view closes the loop with progress, logs, and
recovery actions, turning the console into a practical
daily operations surface.
scenes.action_summary: Shows the runs table with recovery actions and visible operational controls.
